method: Compare RGB SH9 for common valid probes, relative L2 with named reference as denominator. Not a pixel metric or path-tracing ground truth. Fixed per-surfel cosine samples; full reset for each changed generation. Runtime.Bounces controls only reference tracing; cache uses CacheIterations.

gpu_timing.method: ProfileGPU frames captured during a restored-layout solve, 256 surfels/64 rays per batch. Three of five requested captures contained a sweep. Individual dispatch timings only; not full-solve or total-frame costs. No statistical performance guarantee.

automation.fixture: Unoccluded floor plus two downward receivers: E=pi*L and closed-form damped two-step transfer; batches 1 vs 256; final probe rho/pi; zero-light reset. Synthetic constant environment is fixture-only.

memory.note: Computed array sizes, not measured VRAM. Excludes live pool/local seeds, scene BVH/materials, triangle bindings, active slots, SH/resolve and RHI overhead.

limitations: About 10.5% SH difference from reference at default settings; triangle-bound spatial approximation remains.
About 6.4-6.7 seconds for default full solve; old GI cleared until atomic publication.
Whole cache invalidated on layout/light/settings changes; no local dirty regions or history reuse.
One in-flight batch with 16-byte completion readback; final probe SH still read to CPU.
No direct per-pixel cache resolve, temporal MSME, radial depth, Radiance Cascades or mobile/cooked validation.
